app.name: FirstReply
app.tagline: Practice the text that could save a friend's life.
app.footer: FirstReply is a practice tool, not a crisis service. In immediate danger, call 911. In the US, call or text 988 any time.
app.offline: Can't reach the FirstReply server right now.

landing.title: Practice the text that could save a friend's life.
landing.sub: Chat with a simulated friend who's struggling. Models we trained score every reply, keep it safe, and show you exactly where you lost them and what would have worked.
landing.stat: 1 in 5 US high schoolers seriously considered suicide last year.
landing.stat_kicker: The first person they tell is usually a friend.
landing.features_title: Nobody teaches us what to say. So practice it.

practice.title: Practice
practice.body: Text a realistic friend who opens up in layers, but only if you listen, validate and ask directly.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.body: See your trust graph, the exact words that helped or hurt, and better replies that were checked before you see them.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.body: Every message is checked by our Guardian first. Real help is one tap away on every screen, and nothing is stored.

demo.friend1: honestly idk why i even bother anymore
demo.you1: that sounds really heavy. are you thinking about killing yourself?
demo.you2: i'm really glad you told me. can we talk to the counselor tomorrow? i'll go with you

practice.title: Choose a friend to text
practice.sub: Each scenario is a different person and situation. Guarded friends take more patience.

cw.title: Before you start
points: Your friend is simulated. Nothing you type reaches a real person.
You can stop at any time. The "I need help now" button is always at the top.
If any of this feels close to home, please talk to someone. In the US, call or text 988.

chat.xray_on: Turn X-ray mode on: see what our models saw
chat.trust_graph_desc: Trust starts at {start} and is now {now}.
chat.skills_hint: Chips light up when our skill detector notices them.

ended.success_body: You stayed, you asked, and you connected them to help. That's exactly what a friend can do.
ended.fail_body: That's okay. This is practice, and this is how you learn. Let's see what happened.
ended.rewind_hint: Or tap one of your messages to rewind and try a different reply.

crisis.title: Let's pause the practice
crisis.body: It sounds like you might be going through something hard yourself, and that matters more than any practice.
crisis.adult: Talk to a trusted adult today: a parent, counselor, teacher or coach.
crisis.emergency: If you're in immediate danger, call 911.

blocked.title: That message wasn't sent
blocked.teach: In a real conversation, words like that can push someone further away. Try saying what you're worried about, or ask how they're feeling.

chat.concern: If any of this feels close to home, you can call or text 988 any time.

tree.title: Conversation branches
tree.desc: Every rewind starts a new branch. Your current path is highlighted. Tap a message to jump there.

xray.seen: Left on Seen (trust fell too far)

feedback.title: Your feedback
feedback.lost_title: This is where you lost them
feedback.lost_body: Trust dropped by {drop} points after this message.
feedback.no_lost: Trust never dropped. Nice work keeping them with you.
feedback.uncertain_hint: Our two models disagreed here, so treat this score with caution.
feedback.no_messages: You didn't send any messages yet.

whatif.title: What if you'd said something else?
whatif.sub: We replayed the conversation from your message with stronger replies, through the same trust engine and friend line bank.
whatif.simulated_hint: These are simulations, not real people. They show how the model reacts.

real.offline: Showing the copy saved in the app (the server isn't reachable).
real.no_ai: Fixed text written in advance and reviewed. No AI is involved on this page.

how.title: How FirstReply works
how.sub: No chatbot improvises here. Every word the friend can say is written in advance and checked by code. The intelligence is our own trained models, rules and algorithms, running locally for free.
how.pipeline_title: What happens when you hit Send
how.metrics_empty: No evaluation reports yet. Numbers appear here as each part is trained and tested.
does: Detects 10 helping and hurting behaviours in your message, with calibrated probabilities.
Checks every message for safety before anything else runs.
Explains which of your words moved each score.
Suggests better replies, but only ones that score higher when re-checked.
doesnt: It doesn't write the friend's words live. Every line is pre-written and reviewed.
It doesn't give advice for real crises. Real mode is fixed text.
It doesn't diagnose anyone or replace a counselor.
It doesn't use paid AI services or send your messages anywhere.
privacy: No accounts, no names, no emails.
Conversations live only in memory and are deleted after 60 minutes of inactivity.
No analytics, no tracking, no ads, no outside fonts or scripts.
how.try_sub: Type a message as the helper and see what the Guardian decides. Asking a friend directly about suicide is the right move, so it must never be flagged.

checkin.title: How are you feeling after that?
checkin.sub: Practicing this can bring things up. There's no wrong answer.
checkin.low_body: Thank you for saying so. You don't have to carry this alone. Talk to someone you trust, or call or text 988 any time.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: FirstReply is built so there is nothing to leak.
points: No accounts. We never ask for your name, email or age.
Your practice conversation is kept in the server's memory only while you use it, and deleted after 60 minutes of inactivity. It is never written to disk or a database.
No analytics, cookies for tracking, ads or third-party scripts. Fonts are your device's own.
Your language, theme and country choices are saved only in your own browser.
All AI runs on our own server with models we trained. Nothing is sent to an outside AI company.
